final: WITH region_counts AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM client AS c JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), region_shares AS (SELECT region, client_count, 1.0 * client_count / SUM(client_count) OVER () AS share FROM region_counts), shares_with_average AS (SELECT client_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share_across_regions FROM region_shares) SELECT SUM(client_count) AS total_client_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share_across_regions) AS average_excess_share FROM shares_with_average WHERE share > average_share_across_regions
